title: Reconstitution cut: examples confirmed
situation: The reconstitution cut's examples were written cold by the illustrator, revised after the architect settled the boundaries it flagged, and partitioned: 60 visible across workflow, agents and delivery, 11 held out. The operator, 2026-10-10, delegated the rest of the cut human-out-of-the-loop until it is terminal.
decision: The examples are confirmed as they stand on the cut's branch, under the operator's delegation; the architect acts as meaning-holder for all three contexts until the cut is integrated, and they freeze as each check is seen to fail.
consequences: The lead is dispatched with the cut; the cut ends integrated into dev under 0080, and pushing stays the operator's.
